def forward(groups):
    date_part = groups[0]
    time_part = groups[1]
    dt_str = f"20{date_part[:2]}-{date_part[2:4]}-{date_part[4:]} {time_part[:2]}:{time_part[2:4]}:{time_part[4:]}"
    dt = datetime.strptime(dt_str, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
    return {'stored': [int(dt.timestamp() * 1000000)], 'layout': []}

def inverse(record):
    micros = int(record['stored'][0])
    dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(micros / 1000000)
    dt_str = dt.strftime("%y%m%d %H%M%S")
    return dt_str
